decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Amended H1976 101 received: 31/07/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for Prayer Hall and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for Prayer Hall (D1) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 9.00am to 9.00pm.
Condition : 5 - The use shall be carried on only by the Trustees of the Shree Jalaram Seva Trust.
Condition : 6 - No additional windows or other glazed openings to be formed.

Condition : 7 - Prior to construction, details of sound insulation measures for the building shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and the details so approved shall be implemented within three months of the date on which they are approved
Condition : 8 - Three parking spaces shall be kept permanently available at the site for use by visitors and staff of the prayer hall.
Condition : 9 - The windows and doors to all building (including the prayer hall, extension and approved building) shall remain closed at all times when the buildings are in use.
Condition : 10 - No system for the amplification of sound or speech shall be used either within the building or external to the building.

Condition : 11 - No activity shall be carried out outside the existing or approved buildings on the site without the prior written approval of the local planning authority.  Should the applicant wish to carry out activity outside these buildings on certain festival days or for other activities, the application for council permission shall include any means to mitigate against potential harm to residents through the activities of worshippers, including traffic management and parking control measures.
Condition : 12 - An efficient and effective extraction system shall be maintained at all times to deal with cooking odours so that no odour is detectable outside the premises boundary
Condition : 13 - No deliveries or collections, including refuse collection, shall take place between 9.00 pm and 07.00 am on any day and not at all on Sundays or public holidays.
Condition : 14 - The proposed attic space will be used solely for storage ancillary to the D1 (prayer room) use of the main building.
description: Variation of Condition 2 to remove the reference to drawing H1976 101 and replace it with drawing H1976 110 showing a minor amendment to the approved plans of planning application 01054/497A/P3 dated 22.02.2013
